title: No pin: an erase refused a waiting list save, then stopped short (reread-refused, A6)
evidence: From PR 1717's review (R3). No test covers an erase that refused a waiting list save (a medication, screening or supplement on its 300 ms timer) and then stopped short, so the erase machine re-reads with reason 'refused' (lead A6, PR 1382). Since H52 (PR 1717) that re-read's apply runs flushListSaves (widget-src/src/lib/list-saves.ts flushShown, called from widget-src/src/hooks/useRecordApply.ts beside flushPendingSave), so a waiting entry whose erase is still shown fires inside that re-read; nothing pins what then shows and what the record holds. Candidate pin: widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.chat-erase-reply.test.tsx, with a list change waiting when the erase stops short.
